cards.name: 300-TT Crusher Claw
cards.text:
[Pierce 2]

When you put this on a [Guardian] or a character that has 19 [STARS] or more > Tap an enemy [Decepticon]  that has 10 [STARS] or fewer.

cards.name: Aerial Superiority
cards.text: Choose one of your characters. When it attacks this turn, if it's a [Plane], [Helicopter], or [Spaceship] and is attacking a [Truck], [Car], or [Tank] > The chosen character gets +4 [ATK] and [Pierce 4] until end of battle.

cards.name: Apex Armor
cards.text:
Put on [Autobots] only.

When the upgraded character defends and you flip at least [O][K][B] > Move 1 damage counter from the upgraded character to the attacker. Repair 1 damage from the upgraded character. Do 1 damage to the attacker.

cards.name: Beast Mode
cards.text: Choose one of your characters.  When it attacks this turn, if it's a [Predacon] in alt mode or a [Beast], it gets [Bold 4] until end of battle when attacking an enemy in body or bot mode.

cards.name: Bellicosity
cards.text: Choose one of your characters. The first time it attacks this turn and you flip battle cards > Each [B] either player flips this battle is a [O] instead.

cards.name: Cloaking Screen
cards.text: The upgraded character has [Stealth] while untapped.

cards.name: Cloud Cover
cards.text:
[Reveal] > If one or more damage counters would be moved from an enemy to another character.

[When Revealed] > Damage counters can't be moved between characters this turn.

cards.name: Cosmic Rust Cannon
cards.text: When the upgraded character attacks > Do 1 damage to it. After the battle, do another 1 damage to that character unless you scrap an Upgrade from it.

cards.name: Cross-Counter
cards.text:
[Reveal] > When one of your characters defends and you flip battle cards.

[When Revealed] > If your defender's [DEF] is greater than the attacker's [ATK], do damage to the attacker equal to the difference.

modes.text:
[Stealth]

When you flip to this mode > Reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. If it's an Action, you may play it.
When this attacks an [Autobot] > This gets +2 [ATK] until end of turn.

cards.name: Dare to Believe
cards.text:
Draw a card.

One of your characters gets [Bold 1] until end of turn.

cards.name: Enhanced Cyber Blade
cards.text:
Put on [Melee] characters only.

When the upgraded character attacks and you flip at least [B][B] > The defender's base [DEF] becomes 0 during this battle.

cards.name: Feral Tenacity
cards.text:
Put only on [Predacons] or [Beasts].

When the upgraded character takes damage > Put 1 rage counter on this. The upgraded character gets +1 [ATK] for each rage counter on this.

After the upgraded character attacks > Remove all rage counters from this.

cards.name: Grimlock's Sword
cards.text:
Put on [Dinobots] only.

[Bold 3]

[Pierce 3]

cards.name: Heavy-Duty Plasma Blaster
cards.text:
Can't be put on [Decepticons].

When you put this on a [Guardian] or a character in Combiner mode that has 18[STAR] or more > Do 2 damage to an enemy. Then do 1 damage to each other enemy.

cards.name: Mecha Star
cards.text:
[Pierce 2]

When the upgraded character attacks > Scrap this card after the battle.

cards.name: Nothin's Gonna Stand In Our Way
cards.text:
One of your characters gets [Pierce 1] until end of turn.

If this is the third Nothin's Gonna Stand In Our Way you've played this turn > Untap one of your characters with 12 [STARS] or fewer.

You may play another Nothin's Gonna Stand In Our Way.

cards.name: Particle Cannon of Galvatron
cards.text:
Put on Galvatron only.

[Bold 1]

cards.name: Scan the Vaults
cards.text: Draw a card. Then draw a card for each Scan the Vaults in your scrap pile.

cards.name: Spoils of War
cards.text: Choose up to 5 of your characters. If they share a trait, repair 1 damage from each of them.

modes.text: When you flip to this mode > You may scrap a [W] card from your hand. If you do, move 2 damage counters from this to an enemy.
If one of your [Decepticon] or [Unicronian] [Leaders] that has 10 [STAR] or more would take attack damage > You may have this take that damage instead.

sides.text:
Before the game begins > You may reveal a Matrix of Leadership from your deck and put it into your hand.

Up to 3 copies of Matrix of Leadership can fit into the Utility slot of your Rodimus Prime, Worthy Leader.

cards.name: Starscream's Cape
cards.text:
Put on Starscream only.

Increase each number in the upgraded character's text box by 1. This effect does not modify abilities granted by Upgrades or other effects.

cards.name: Stasis Field
cards.text:
[Reveal] > When one of your characters defends against an enemy in bot or body mode.

[When Revealed] > Your opponent flips that enemy to alt mode.

cards.name: Stormfall Sword
cards.text:
[Pierce 2]

While this is on Windblade > She has [Tough 1].

cards.name: The Touch
cards.text:
One of your [Autobot] [Leaders] gets [Bold 3] until end of turn.

If that character is upgraded with Matrix of Leadership > Repair 3 damage from it.

cards.name: This is Bad Comedy
cards.text:
Choose one >
• Scrap an enemy Utility.
• Do 1 damage to an enemy that doesn't have a Utility.

cards.name: Trithyllium Plating
cards.text:
When you play this from hand > You may play a Trithyllium Plating from your scrap pile.

While the upgraded character is defending against an enemy that has [Pierce] > Reduce that enemy's [Pierce] total by 2.

cards.name: Twisted Logic
cards.text:
[Reveal] > When one of your characters defends.

[When Revealed] > Reveal the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. Put them back in any order.

cards.name: Vamparc Ribbon
cards.text: When the upgraded character attacks and does 5 or more attack damage > Repair 2 damage from the upgraded character.

cards.name: Wanna Bet?
cards.text:
[Reveal] > If one or more battle cards would be put under an enemy character.

[When Revealed] > Until end of turn, if one or more battle cards would be put under an enemy character, scrap those battle cards instead.

modes.text: When you flip to this mode > You may scrap an enemy Upgrade.
When this attacks, if his Upgrades include at least [W][B][G] and you flip at least [W][O][K] > Do 4 damage to an enemy.

sides.text: Once per game, at the start of your turn > You may put a [Battle Master] upgrade from your KO area onto your Raider Spinister, Infantry • Aerial Assault. If you do, flip this.

At the end of your turn, if you have both Beastbox, Savage Interrogator and Squawktalk, Chatterbox Translator on the battlefield and/or in the KO area in bot mode > You may scrap two cards from your hand. If you do, combine Beastbox and Squawktalk into Squawkbox, Passionate Musician.

modes.text:
Before the game begins > KO this.
When your Starscream is KO'd, if this is in in your KO area > Return this to the battlefield fully repaired, even if you have no other characters. Put all Upgrades from the KO'd Starscream onto this instead of scrapping them.
When this attacks > You may tap an enemy.
When this attacks and you flip at least [O][K][B] > Do 1 damage to EACH character, then do 1 damage to EACH [Decepticon].
[Bold 3]

sides.text: Once per game, at the start of your turn > You may put a [Battle Master] upgrade from your KO area on to your Sergeant Crosshairs, Artillery • Weapons Supervisor. If you do, flip this.

modes.text: When you flip to this mode > You may scrap a card from your hand. If you do, return a [B] Utility from your scrap pile to hand.

sides.text: When your Ironhide, Veteran Autobot battles a [Decepticon] > He gets [Bold 2] and [Tough 2] until end of battle.

modes.text: When one of your cards KO's this without doing damage to it > Do 2 damage to an enemy [Autobot].

[Bold 1] 
If another Upgrade would be put into the same Upgrade slot as this > Scrap that Upgrade instead.
If this would leave the battlefield while upgrading a [Decepticon] [Leader] that has 10 [STAR] or more > Instead Deploy this to the battlefield in bot mode tapped with 7 damage on him.

sides.text:
While your Bombshell, Decepticon Psy Ops is defending against an attacker that has [Pierce] > Reduce the attacker's [Pierce] total based on the number of cards in your hand. 
• 1-4  Reduce the attackers' [Pierce] total by 2. 
• 5-7  Reduce the attackers' [Pierce] total by 3. 
• 8+  Reduce the attackers' [Pierce] total by 4.

modes.text: [Tough 1]
[Revenge] > Your opponent scraps a card from their hand.

sides.text: Replace the text "an enemy that doesn't have [Pierce]" on your Autobot Jazz, Special Ops with "an enemy that has 8 [STARS] or fewer."

modes.text:
[Stealth]
When you flip to this mode > Return a card at random from your scrap pile to hand.
After you flip battle cards for this character's attack and before defense flips > You may play one of the [K] Utilities you flipped.

sides.text: When your Bluestreak, Reluctant Soldier defends in bot mode and you flip at least [W][O][B] > The attacker's base [ATK] becomes 0 during this battle.

modes.text: When you flip to this mode > Return a Matrix of Leadership from your scrap pile to hand.
While this is upgraded with the Matrix of Leadership > He has +1 [ATK] and [Pierce 2].

sides.text: When you flip your Inferno, Fearless Firefighter to bot mode > Repair 1 damage from one of your [Autobots].

modes.text:

When this attacks > You may scrap a [B] card from your hand. If you do, this gets +2 [ATK] until end of turn.

When this battles an enemy in bot mode > This gets +1 [ATK] and +1 [DEF] until end of turn.

sides.text: Your Red Alert, Security Chief has "When you flip to this mode > You may scrap a card from your hand. If you do, repair 1 damage from each of your characters."

modes.text:
Your starting [STAR] limit is increased by 2 if  Omega Supreme is on your starting team.
This has [Stealth] while you have Omega Supreme on the battlefield.

[TAP], Scrap a card from your hand > Draw 2 cards, then put a card from your hand on top of your deck. If you have a character in Combiner mode, instead draw 3 cards, then put a card from your hand  on top of your deck.

sides.text: Each of your [Firecons] has +2 [HEALTH]. Before the game begins > You may reveal a Firecon Flame from your deck and put it into your hand.

modes.text:
[Stealth]

When you flip to this mode > Choose a battle icon color. Then your opponent reveals the top card of their deck. If it has a battle icon of the chosen color, draw 2 cards.
When this attacks > Each player chooses a card from their hand and scraps it.

sides.text: Your deck can have up to 2 extra [STAR] of [W] cards. Once per game at the start of your turn > You may deploy a character from under your Trypticon, Assault Base to the battlefield. If you do, flip this.

When your Megatron, Decepticon Leader is on the battlefield and you flip Hunker Down while battling > After the battle, you may swap a card from your hand for a Hunker Down you flipped this battle as though it had [G].

modes.text: This has [Stealth] against [Decepticons] and [Quintessons].
[TAP], Scrap a card from your hand > Your opponent chooses one of their characters and does 1 damage to it. If the scrapped card has one or fewer battle icons, instead do 2 damage to an enemy.
When you flip to this mode > Reveal the top 3 cards from your deck. Put up to 2 of those cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
If this would take attack damage and you flipped battle icons of at least four different colors this battle > Instead this takes half that damage rounded up.

When this is combined > Each player chooses a card from their hand and scraps it. You draw a card for each card scrapped this way.

When this attacks an [Autobot] > Your opponent may scrap a card from their hand. If they don't, you draw a card.

When one of your other [Dinobots] in alt mode defends > It can't take more than 6 attack damage this battle. You may have this take up to 3 of that damage, but not enough to KO this, and the other character takes the rest.
When you flip to this mode > If you have another damaged or KO'd [Autobot], this gets +1 [ATK] until end of turn. If that character is a [Dinobot], this gets +2 [ATK] until end of turn instead.

cards.text:
Can't be put on [Autobots].

Up to 2 Imperator Claws can fit in 1 Weapon slot of a [Decepticon] [Titan].

When the upgraded character attacks and you flip at least [O][K][B] > Do 1 damage to each character that has fewer [STARS] than it.

cards.name: Zarak Shield
cards.text:
While this is on a [Titan] > It has +1 [DEF].

While this is on Lord Zarak > He can't take more than 4 attack damage from a single attack.

modes.text:
Before the game begins > You may reveal an Electro-Stinger from your deck and put it into your hand.

When you flip to this mode > Draw a card.

This begins with Lord Zarak, Ruler of Nebulos on him in head mode.
When this attacks > You may play one of your flipped Upgrades onto this after battle. If you don't play an Upgrade this way, flip this.

[Head] + [Bold 1], [Tough 1], [Focus 1]

This begins on Scorponok, Brutal Warlord in head mode. This can't flip.

When Scorponok is KO'd > Deploy this to the battlefield in bot mode, even if Scorponok was your last character.

[Bold 1], [Tough 1], [Focus 1]

When you deploy this from under Scorponok > You may put a Zarak Shield from Scorponok onto this.

cards.name: Combaticon Enigma
cards.text:
If you have Bruticus on the battlefield > He gets [Pierce 2] until end of turn.

If you have 5 [Combaticons] in bot mode on the battlefield and/or in your KO area > Combine them into Bruticus, Unstoppable Giant.

cards.name: Lock and Load
cards.text: You may play a [K] Upgrade onto one of your [Decepticons] > It gets +1 [ATK] until end of turn.

cards.name: United Front
cards.text:
One of your characters gets +2 [ATK] until end of turn.

If it's in combiner mode > Repair 2 damage from it.

cards.name: Unfriendly Fire
cards.text:
Put on [Combaticons] only.

When the upgraded character defends and your opponent flips battle icons of at least 3 different colors > Do 1 damage to an enemy.

modes.text: When this attacks a [Tank] or [Truck] > This gets +2 [ATK] until end of turn.

[Brave]
While this has 4 or more damage counters > He gets +1 [DEF].
Each of your [Combaticons] has [Bold 1] and [Tough 1] while upgraded with a [K] Upgrade.
Enemies can't use [Plan].
When you play your second Upgrade during your turn > Draw a card.
When this battles an enemy from a different faction > You may play a [K] Weapon or a [K] Armor onto one of your other characters that shares a trait with this.
[Pierce 2]
When you flip to this mode > Your opponent reveals a card at random from their hand. If it's an Upgrade, scrap it.

[Tough 2], [Pierce 2]
When this attacks on the turn he's combined > For each battle card you flip that has at least [K], do 1 damage to an enemy.
